scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence for Episode 14 of Behind the Scenes.

scenes.title: The Boss Who Is Never Late
scenes.summary: Kaiwen teases Bu Xiaogu about admiring a famous singer just before Chun Yuqiao arrives late to work for the very first time alongside Xin Huimei and gently apologises to her.

scenes.title: How Falling in Love Changed the Boss
scenes.summary: As the crew gets to work, Kaiwen, Xingzi, and Bu Xiaogu marvel at how Chun Yuqiao's sharp edges softened around Xin Huimei, right before Chun Yuqiao waves Xiaogu over.

scenes.title: The Challenge of Greenlighting an Original Show
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao gives Bu Xiaogu ten minutes to critique his original reality-show concept, and she analyses both its strong emotional pull for young workers and the industry's fear of backing domestic originals.

scenes.title: Assigning a Case-Study Thesis
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao assigns Bu Xiaogu to write a research paper tracking the greenlighting of his original show with full access to his files, reminding her that senior producers must study as well as execute.

scenes.title: A Second Chance at Her Degree
scenes.summary: Professor Fang phones Bu Xiaogu with news that she can submit a thesis alongside this year's graduating class to earn back her lost master's degree, and she eagerly pitches her new topic.

scenes.title: Morning Surprise on the Commute
scenes.summary: On her morning walk to work, Bu Xiaogu receives a playful congratulatory gift celebrating her promotion and second chance at graduation.

scenes.title: Professor Fang's Approval and a Quiet Secret
scenes.summary: Professor Fang warmly endorses Bu Xiaogu's new thesis topic; outside Chun Yuqiao's office she resolves to keep unspoken feelings tucked away, right before the chairwoman whisks her off for the day.
scenes.location: Xingtian hallway and underground car park

scenes.title: Mutual Trust Over Bu Xiaogu and Xin Huimei
scenes.summary: In a private meeting with Xin Huimei's fan-club president, Chun Yuqiao answers questions about his student days abroad, accepts advice to stay patient, and promises to look after Bu Xiaogu.

scenes.title: Admiring Her One True Idol
scenes.summary: After hours of shopping and gossiping with Xingtian's chairwoman without talking work, Bu Xiaogu admits she has admired Chun Yuqiao since college and jokes about her youthful boldness.

scenes.title: Renaming the Show Charming Voyage
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu tells the chairwoman how working under Chun Yuqiao affirmed her dream, and together they brainstorm a livelier, more dynamic title for his new reality show.

scenes.title: Strategic Investment and Agency Merger
scenes.summary: At an executive banquet, a major conglomerate announces a pre-IPO investment merging its talent agency into Xingtian, with Xingtian unveiling Charming Voyage as a flagship star project.

scenes.title: First-Choice Casting and Standing By Her Boyfriend
scenes.summary: When the merged agency reveals Chun Yuqiao's first-choice star has been shelved and pushes a replacement idol onto his show, Xin Huimei arrives, introduces Chun Yuqiao as her boyfriend, and drinks a toast in his stead.

scenes.title: Late-Night Takeout While Writing the Thesis
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu works late at her desk racing to finish her master's thesis over takeout noodles.

scenes.title: Refusing to Let Him Bear Every Grievance Alone
scenes.summary: Returning from the party, Xin Huimei deliberately provokes an argument to make Chun Yuqiao stop hiding his stomach pain behind polite apologies, leading to a tender reconciliation.

scenes.title: Couture Shirt Gossip and a Rude Idol
scenes.summary: Xingzi and Kaiwen joke about Chun Yuqiao's designer shirt and mellower mood until furious Xiaoye storms in after the newly arrived agency idol wiped dirt onto her coat.

scenes.title: Even Scarier When He Stays Calm
scenes.summary: When the arrogant idol's entourage brawls with Lin Jie's crew, Chun Yuqiao stays eerily calm, reviews Ji Xiu's report exposing the idol's inflated popularity data, and summons Kaiwen.

scenes.title: Isolating the Star With VIP Hotel Rules
scenes.summary: At a luxury hotel suite, Kaiwen flatters the replacement idol with dedicated round-the-clock Xingtian staff and smoothly persuades him to send all of his own agency handlers home.

scenes.title: Surprise Dawn Cameras and Diving Drills
scenes.summary: Rolling cameras at dawn with personal phones confiscated under island-training rules, the Xingtian crew marches the unprepared, water-phobic idol straight to an eighty-minute scuba drill.
scenes.location: hotel room and indoor diving pool

scenes.title: Shopping Lists Before Flying Overseas
scenes.summary: Xingzi hands thrilled Bu Xiaogu a duty-free shopping list before Xiaogu and Kaiwen depart overseas as the advance reality-show crew, and Chun Yuqiao reminds Xiaogu to finish her thesis draft first.

scenes.title: Chun Yuqiao Never Bargains Over Casting
scenes.summary: When the furious agency head confronts Chun Yuqiao after the water-phobic replacement star drops out, Chun Yuqiao reveals multi-angle hotel footage and insists on his original first-choice lead without bargaining.
